parameters.content:
## AI Candidate Screening & Interview Automation

### How it works

This workflow automates candidate screening from application intake through interview follow-up. It receives a candidate application, extracts and stores the resume, records the candidate in Google Sheets, then uses an AI agent to evaluate fit against the role. Based on the resulting score, it updates the candidate record and sends the appropriate interview invitation or HR notification email.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook endpoint and connect it to the application form or career-site submission source.
- Add Google Drive credentials and set the destination folder for uploaded resumes.
- Add Google Sheets credentials and configure the candidate tracking spreadsheet, including columns for candidate details, resume link, AI evaluation, and score/status.
- Configure the OpenAI chat model credentials and adjust the structured output parser to match the evaluation fields expected by the Google Sheets update step.
- Add Gmail credentials and review the email recipients, subjects, and templates for interview invitations, passed-candidate HR alerts, and manual-review alerts.
- Set the score threshold and branch conditions in the interview score check node to match the hiring process.

### Customization

Customize the AI evaluation prompt, scoring rubric, Google Sheets schema, and email templates for each job role or hiring stage.

## Receive and parse application

Starts the workflow from an incoming candidate application and safely extracts resume/application data for downstream processing.

## Store resume and candidate

Uploads the converted resume to Google Drive, prepares a shareable resume link, and adds the initial candidate record to Google Sheets.

## Evaluate candidate with AI

Uses the AI agent with its OpenAI chat model and structured output parser to assess the candidate, then writes the evaluation results back to Google Sheets.

## Route interview outcome

Checks the AI-generated interview score and sends the appropriate Gmail message: interview invitation, HR passed-candidate notification, or manual review notification.
